newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lonhro Belgium to change name.
newsitem.headline: Lonhro Belgium to change name.

text.p: Lonhro Belgium SA, an 82.5 percent unit of Lonhro Plc, plans to change its name to Lonhro Continental at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on December 20.
In a notice in Belgian newspapers to alert shareholders to the meeting the company gave no reason for the planned change.
Officials were not immediately available to comment.
Lonhro Belgium has interests in Belgium in property, the distribution of mining equipment and a travel agency. It also has various interests in property and commodities in Zaire.
Control of Lonhro Plc, which is presently splitting up its hotels, trading and mining businesses, recently passed to South African mines group Anglo American.
